annotations.title: Commute times from a London district

description: Typical door-to-door public transport minutes (TfL Journey Planner, 09:00 weekday departure) from a London postcode district to London work hubs, quickest first, with the district's quickest sector. Hubs: canary-wharf (Canary Wharf), city-of-london (Bank / Liverpool Street / Moorgate), kings-cross (King's Cross), westminster (Westminster), oxford-circus (Oxford Circus), london-bridge (London Bridge), paddington (Paddington), stratford (Stratford), hammersmith (Hammersmith), victoria (Victoria), waterloo (Waterloo), farringdon (Farringdon).

district.description: A London postcode district (outward code) such as "E17" or "SW11", or a full postcode such as "E17 4QH".

hub.description: One hub only; leave out for all 12.
